test_title: PYST 33: SSC CHSL 2024 - Quantitative Aptitude (Held On: 11 Jul, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: maths
question:
Study the given graph and answer the question that follows.

The graph shows the marks obtained by Riya and Rida in six subjects in the CBSE 12th exam. The maximum marks in Maths, Physics and Chemistry are 140, and that in English, IP and Biology are 180.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d47594fff2524a88d3e2eec9294f50fd9371d98aa87e053fe0ec9d4a18f00e3d.png] 

What is the difference between the percentage of marks obtained by Riya and Rida in IP?
solution:
**Given:**

Marks obtained by Riya in IP = 150

Marks obtained by Rida in IP = 130

Maximum marks in IP = 180

**Formula used:**

Percentage = (Marks obtained / Maximum marks) × 100

**Calculation:**

Difference in marks obtained by Riya and Rida = 150 - 130 = 20

So, % Difference = (20/180) × 100 = 1/9 × 100 = 11.11%

**∴ The difference between the percentage of marks obtained by Riya and Rida in IP is 11.11%.**
